key_result: Result accuracy ranged from 16.2% to 36.8% across nine agent configurations; in an audit, 193 of 380 runs that passed result checks (50.8%) had point-in-time violations.
takeaway: A benchmark of 408 Chinese-language investment research tasks that checks whether agents respect disclosure cutoffs in historical data.
title: BuySideFlow: A Point-in-Time Benchmark for LLM Agents in Investment Research
why_it_matters: It shows that a correct-looking answer can still rest on data that was not available at the time.
